citations.assessment: Nedarim describes the betrothal to his daughter and their marriage; Ketubot gives the daughter-of-Ben-Kalba-Savua wording. Preserve this entry’s Kalba Savua heading.
The exact Almanac paragraph presents Kalba Savua as Zedekiah’s tikkun and juxtaposes their respective vows. Keep the historical and spiritual claims distinct and preserve the unconverted year.
